newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT-Dlr/yen resting before scaling 116.33 high.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Dlr/yen resting before scaling 116.33 high.

text.p: Dollar/yen will probably consolidate briefly after hurdling 115 on Thurdsay, but further short covering could spur it over its 116.33 overnight high before the U.S. holiday weekend, analysts said.

Weighing the risk of a steeper retracement of dollar/yen's two week skid, speculators may opt not to incur the cost of carrying short-dollar positions versus the lower-yielding yen for the Memorial Day long weekend, they said.
"We probably get to about 116.75 yen, maybe a little above," said David Solin, partner at Foreign Exchange Analytics.
"As we saw last night, once short covering starts it can run quite a bit," he added.
The 62-percent Fibonacci retracement of the decline from the 119.74 yen high on May 12 to 111.98 yen on Tuesday presents 116.75 as an upside target, Solin said.
Other analysts said in the short-term dollar/yen should trade sideways with a slight upward bias, but opportunities for renewed selling should soon present themselves.

"If we get above 116.40 (yen), you could go to 117.00 to 117.50," said Ture Johnson, technical analyst at Bank of America. "But if we were to get that high, I would look to start selling them up there."
Johnson's chartpoint targets coincide with daily highs on May 16 and May 15, respectively.
Johnson said the dollar will probably go into a holding pattern above 115 yen for the next couple of days.
Further support lies at 114.70 and 114.45 yen, chartists said.
Dollar/mark is also in a range. Experts said the best strategy is to fade the rally, while being prepared to protect yourself by purchasing above 1.72.

"We've got some pretty good resistance coming in at 1.7020, we got pretty close to it last night," said Johnson. "If we were to get above 1.7020 marks, then you go back up to 1.71 to 1.7160 and then you sell it, with a stop above 1.72 marks."
At 1200 EDT/1600 GMT on Thursday, the dollar stood at 1.6950/60 marks, up from 1.6930/35 at the open and at 115.87/92 yen, little changed from 115.85/95.
